beats.vo: Thirty-one seasons. One title. This is our whole story.
beats.dlg: 31 SEASONS. 1 TITLE.|THIS IS OUR WHOLE STORY.

beats.vo: November third, nineteen ninety-five. Our first game. The name came from a nationwide contest, right after Jurassic Park.
beats.dlg: 1995: OUR FIRST GAME.|A NAME FROM JURASSIC PARK.

beats.name: CARTER
beats.vo: Nineteen ninety-eight. A draft-day trade brings us Vince Carter.
beats.dlg: 1998: A DRAFT-DAY TRADE|BRINGS US VINCE CARTER.

beats.name: CARTER
beats.vo: Two thousand one. Our first playoff series win. Then Game seven, and his last shot rolls off the rim.
beats.dlg: 2001: OUR FIRST SERIES WIN.|GAME 7: IT ROLLS OFF.

beats.head: THEY LEAVE
beats.name: BOSH

beats.name: LOWRY
beats.vo: DeMar and Kyle make us a playoff team. But Cleveland ends our season three years running.

beats.name: LEONARD

beats.head: CHAPTER 32
beats.vo: Season thirty-two is five and seven so far. How does this chapter end? Comment below.
beats.dlg: SEASON 32: 5-7 SO FAR.|HOW DOES THIS ONE END?

caption:
31 SEASONS. 1 TITLE. 🎮🏀 This is our whole story.

• Nov 3, 1995: our first game. The name came from a nationwide contest, inspired by Jurassic Park
• 1998: a draft-day trade brings us Vince Carter
• 2001: our first playoff series win. In Game 7 of the next round, his last shot rolls off the rim
• 2004: Vince traded to New Jersey. 2010: Bosh signs with Miami
• 2016-18: DeMar and Kyle, and Cleveland ends our season 3 years running
• July 18, 2018: DeMar for Kawhi. 2019: our first title, 4-2 over Golden State
• 2020-21: home games in Tampa. Then a rebuild, and Scottie
• 2026: Kawhi's back

How does chapter 32 end? 👇

facts.claim: The Raptors played their first game on November 3 (Nov 3), 1995; founded in 1995 (expansion); the name was chosen through a nationwide contest, influenced by the popularity of the 1993 film Jurassic Park; 31 seasons from 1995-96 through 2025-26, so 2026-27 is season 32; one (1) NBA title (2019)
Vince Carter acquired through a draft-day trade in 1998 (Antawn Jamison to Golden State)
2001: Carter led the team to its first playoff series win (3-2 over New York); the next series came down to the last seconds of Game 7, when Carter's potential series-winning shot rolled off the rim
Carter was traded in 2004 to the New Jersey Nets; Bosh departed to sign with the Miami Heat in July 2010
Cleveland eliminated Toronto in 2016 (4-2, third round), 2017 (second round, 4-0) and 2018 (second round sweep): 3 years running, 2016-18
July 18, 2018: DeRozan traded to San Antonio for Kawhi Leonard and Danny Green; 2019: first NBA championship, 4-2 over the Golden State Warriors
2020-21: home games at Amalie Arena in Tampa, Florida
Barnes: NBA Rookie of the Year (2022), 2x NBA All-Star (2024, 2026)
Leonard: on September 14, 2026 traded back to Toronto (2026)
